title: Al-Burhan fi Usul al-Fiqh
author: al-juwayni
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Juwayni's major treatise on legal theory, notable for its independent judgements against both al-Shafi'i and al-Ash'ari and for its treatment of the purposes of the law, which his student al-Ghazali developed further.
historicalContext: The Burhan belongs to the theologians' school of usul, which reasons from first principles rather than from the established cases of a school. Its difficulty earned it a reputation as 'the puzzle of the community'.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
